'''Jaina Solo's lightsaber''' was a weapon constructed by [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] at the [[Jedi Praxeum|Jedi academy]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] in [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]], when she was a teenager.

==History==
===Creation===
[[File:Second_Battle_of_Roche.jpg|thumb|Jaina using her lightsaber to battle Jacen]]
At the age of thirteen, Jaina began attending [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|her uncle's]] [[Jedi Praxeum]]. There, along with the rest of her class, she constructed her lightsaber, along with synth crystals, that would produce a purple blade.
